_meta.selection: MICHELIN Guide New York 2025 selection, announced 18 November 2025 (69 starred restaurants: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star in New York City).
_meta.star_caveat: THE NEXT NEW YORK CEREMONY IS SCHEDULED FOR 14 DECEMBER 2026 — before this trip. Re-verify every star after that date. Nothing on this page should be treated as final for Feb/Mar 2027.
_meta.one_star_discrepancy: MICHELIN's own New York filter reports 50 one-star restaurants in New York City; the 18 Nov 2025 announcement lists 52 one-star names including La Bastide by Andrea Calstier (North Salem, Westchester) and borough venues. The difference is FLAGGED here, not reconciled.
_meta.price_rule: MICHELIN publishes only a price band ($–$$$$). No per-couple dollar total is shown unless a restaurant's own site published one — none did for the venues checked, so the column is blank and flagged.
_meta.in_or_near_nyc: Blue Hill at Stone Barns (Tarrytown) and La Bastide (North Salem) are outside the NYC subway network. They are kept in the list for completeness and marked 'outside transit rule'.
_meta.cluster_rule: A cluster is only filled where the MICHELIN page (or its own blurb) names the area. 52 of 72 rows currently have no verified neighbourhood and are shown as 'Not yet grouped' rather than being assigned a guess from a street address.
